name: Remnant Muzzleswell
description: Sweep the horizon from left to right in one slow turn of the head to find every distinct mark.

name: Energizing Linstock
description: Hold the spyglass to one eye and keep the other open to judge both the far mark and the near ground.

name: Waningshot
description: Read a wind feather tied atop a pole to judge the drift along the whole flight path.

name: Equipoise Gunbore
description: Set a point of qi on the far mark and lay the bore on that point.

name: Chimequoin
description: Look through the dust of an earlier shot with qi in the eyes to see the mark behind it.

name: Intent Wheelhub
description: Slow the heartbeat with a long breath so the lay of the gun holds true across a long wait.

name: Iron Breechrope
description: Lay the bore along a thread of qi to the far mark and fire so the ball pierces the cover there.

name: Blaze Ballshot
description: Lift the breech to a steep angle and fire so the ball falls onto a distant mark from above.

name: Booming Recoil
description: Gather qi into the ball through five heartbeats and fire one shot that falls like a stooping hawk on a distant mark.

name: Cannonade Slipstream
description: Pace out the angle between two guns so their lines of fire will cross at the intended point.

name: Beneficent Cascabel
description: Drive two stakes at the crossing of the two guns' lines and tie a cord between them.

name: Equipoise Quoin
description: Call the notch settings between the two gunners until both sit in agreement.

name: Intentcannon
description: Wave a cloth to move smoke from the crossing lane so both gunners keep the mark in view.

name: Impenetrable Trunnion
description: Step across to cover the neighbouring gun's flank when its crew is struck down.

name: Veritycannon
description: Hold the two bearings in mind as a single cross until the crossing point becomes the mark.

name: Gustshot
description: Fire both guns within a single breath so their balls reach the crossing point together.

name: Carriage Premonition
description: One gun fires while the other reloads and then they trade places in an unbroken rhythm.

name: Fastening Touchhole
description: Fire both guns along their crossing lines so any foe entering the lane between them meets converging shot.

name: Downpour Recoil
description: Open the lines of both guns like the blades of shears across a column as it passes the crossing.

name: Lot Cascabel
description: Send two balls through the crossing on a single count so the first breaks cover and the second meets those who run.

name: Prescient Breechrope
description: Walk the river bank to learn where a column must bunch up to pass a bend.

name: Facet Muzzleswell
description: Dig the trail spade into the bank so the flank gun holds a hard angle.

name: Aegisquoin
description: Crouch among reeds along the bank so the gun's place is hidden from the far side.

name: Headlong Roar
description: Carry cartridges along the low bank beneath its lip so the carrier stays unseen from the road.

name: Lacerating Ballshot
description: Lay the muzzle along the long axis of a column so the ball runs the length of it.

name: Energizing Touchhole
description: Read the ruffle of the water's surface for the wind that lies along the lane.

name: Shotinsight
description: Mark the ford where a column must close up and set the elevation on that choke.

name: Roarruin
description: Fire along the flank of a column so each ball runs down the line and strikes rank after rank.

name: Septic Carriage
description: Lay a gun in the bank's shadow on a marked point and fire as the head of the column crosses the ford.

name: Hellish Linstock
description: Fire a qi-driven ball along the long line of a column to carry through ranks of men and shields.

name: Vitalshot
description: Cut and roll the blue-dyed fuse paper to a fixed length so every shell has a known burst count.

name: Vital Gunbore
description: Two crewmen lift the shell by its straps and set it in the muzzle in one smooth motion.

name: Wary Wheelhub
description: Count the shells in the cradle against the rounds the gun will fire before moving up.

name: Quoinrespite
description: Listen for the double crack of a shell and its echo to judge where in the air it burst.

name: Waningcannon
description: Pinch the quick match between finger and thumb to feel that it is dry and unbroken.

name: Resurgent Quoin
description: Run a thread of qi along the fuse to slow its burn by a single heartbeat.

name: Might Trunnion
description: Pair a short fuse and a long fuse in two shells so they burst a heartbeat apart.

name: Siltshot
description: Drop a shell over a river bank so it rolls down and bursts at the water's edge.

name: Waning Gunbore
description: Lean on the quoin for half a notch to raise or lower the height of the burst.

name: Slag Cannonade
description: Fire two shells with fuses a breath apart so the first scatters foes and the second bursts on those who fled.

name: Blaze Bombard
description: Fire a long-fused shell so it falls into a trench and bursts among the men taking cover.

name: Mayhemquoin
description: Fire a volley of shells that burst overhead in turn and fill the air above the target with iron.

name: Ferocious Silt Broadside
description: Gather qi into one great shell and burst it high so the sky above the target fills with flying iron.

name: Elevating Carriage
description: Post two spotters on two heights to call range and drift to the gun in turn.

name: Resurgent Breechrope
description: Pass two slates between spotter and gunner so correction and confirmation return together.

name: Resurgent Touchhole
description: Count paces and breaths together to cross-check the range from both ways.

name: Cannoninsight
description: Compare the splash seen from two heights to place the next shot with greater exactness.

name: Clairvoyant Muzzleswell
description: Pass a short note of qi from spotter to gunner so the correction needs no shouted word.

name: Phantom Trunnion
description: Move a spotter to a new perch as soon as the first is marked out by the enemy.

name: Facet Roar
description: Fire a first shot to learn the range so the second lands exactly where the ranging pair called it.

name: Hoarfrost Cannonade
description: Walk the lay along a moving mark on the spotter's call until the ball is sure to meet it.

name: Reverberating Ballshot
description: Hold spotter and gunner to one breath and one count so the ball falls on an unseen mark exactly as called.

name: Cascabel Vitality
description: Listen to the echo off the basin rim to judge from which side an enemy gun fired.

name: Beneficent Wheelhub
description: Look for the faint dust ring thrown up by an enemy gun's blast and mark its bearing.

name: Mightcannon
description: Drop a cloth flag the moment an enemy gun fires so the crews learn the time.

name: Linstock Respite
description: Reset the quoin to the counter notch learned from the last answering shot.

name: Inexorable Gunbore
description: Crouch behind the wheel between the enemy flash and the arriving ball.

name: Chime Muzzleswell
description: Cross the echo bearing with the flash bearing to narrow the enemy gun to a small patch.

name: Rumble Broadside
description: Fire back at the place the cross bearing marks before the enemy crew has reloaded.

name: Facet Quoin
description: Light smoke pots forward of the gun so the enemy lays on the smoke instead of the carriage.

name: Might Recoil
description: Pull the gun back onto the basin floor out of the enemy's line of fire.

name: Brutalizing Broadside
description: Follow the echo of the enemy gun with a quick series of rounds until one lands on the carriage.

name: Toxin Roar
description: Hold fire behind the basin rim until the enemy fires and then reply in the very same breath.

name: Roarvalor
description: Fire one heavy ball with full qi at the enemy gun's carriage to silence the piece and cow its crew.
